description: This file defines functions and constants for handling V8 union types in the Blink rendering engine, including managing includes, member contexts, and union type analysis.

methods.name: container_context
methods.description: Analyzes a union type to determine its constituent types and generate include and declaration info.

methods.name: _update_includes_and_forward_decls
methods.description: Updates include and forward declaration sets based on a member and interface info.

methods.name: member_context
methods.description: Generates context information for a union member, including C++ and V8 type info.
